definitions: Someone or something is constantly occupying one's thoughts, often to an annoying or obsessive degree.
A person or thing is frequently thought about without any effort or intention from the thinker.
examples: That catchy song is living rent-free in my head.
My ex is still living rent-free in my head, even after all these years.
The upcoming exam is living rent-free in my head.
source: he's living rent-free in my head
